nonBlocking: Model can yield an estimated fertile interval overlapping the estimated bleeding interval (21-day cycle/10-day period); do not label any dates safe or use the overlap as clinical evidence.
Put the eligible regular-cycle assumptions close to the form, not only in the FAQ; remove text-only tool's synthetic file boilerplate.

primarySources.observation: FIGO 2018: common 24–38 day reference; even predictable cycles do not always ovulate.
HHS OWH describes 24–38 day reference, and timing variation even with regular cycles.
HHS labels window and dates as estimates only, not birth control/medical advice.
ASRM guidance body (2026 edition) describes typical 12–14 days but variable 11–17; fixed 14 days is a model assumption.
